title: heap overflow in statDecodePage; needs -DSQLITE_ENABLE_DBSTAT_VTAB
live_proof: fuzz-corpus diff: the image reproduces on stock 3.22.0 under host ASan as a SEGV / out-of-bounds read in statDecodePage at sqlite3.c:177956
object: the page buffer statDecodePage walks while reporting dbstat rows
lifetime_ender: not a lifetime defect: a corrupt page makes the cell-pointer walk leave the buffer
shape: read past the end of the record
fidelity: real consumer, real allocator, with a reconstructed trigger (see case 34). Needs -DSQLITE_ENABLE_DBSTAT_VTAB, without which the statement fails with 'no such table: dbstat' and the case passes having tested nothing

sublet.oracle: VM HALTED on a capability fault, cause 24 untagged dereference (temporal: revoked, or never a capability) pc=0x800239e4 -- taken outside the domain, so cooperative recovery has no frame to return through; all 28 halts in this arm are at the same kernel pc 0x800239e4

The plain build does not fault.
